The '''singing fern''' was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Swamp/Legends|marshy]] [[Agrilat Region]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The [[Fern (plant)/Legends|fern]] was a [[crystal plant]], meaning that, as with most [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the Agrilat Region, it was composed of a mixture of dense, hard [[Silica/Legends|silica]] and organic materials, which gave it a [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] appearance. Singing ferns both absorbed light and glowed softly.<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The singing fern was mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a<ref name="SoF" /> [[2014]]<ref name="Sights">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2014/1/24/set-your-sights-on-corellia|text=Set Your Sights on Corellia|date=2014-01-24}}</ref> sourcebook published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' module ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''.<ref name="SoF" />
